name: Groudon (CobbleEffort form)
look: a hunched titan in white steel armour joined by glowing red seams: a slatted steel visor over a red face, black cheek guards, a slate-blue chest, bronze belly bands, white gauntlets with black claws and a bolted bronze tail curling up to a crescent blade
entry: Its body is armour forged in the heat of the earth's core, and magma glows through every seam. When it raises the sun, iron runs molten from the rocks around it, and it swings its tail blade like a smith's hammer.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in badlands by day, and the Nether's basalt deltas and wastes.
